name: Maximum Security Boyfriend
source:
You play as a new inmate trying to survive daily life behind bars while navigating strange relationships, absurd prison routines, and increasingly unstable situations. Nothing in this facility is normal, and that includes its staff, its inmates, and whatever passes for “security protocol”.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4636620/]Steam[/url]]
